page.layout: Running head centred at top; below it a title in two lines, then one block of verse in one column; the author's name in bold at lower right. No notes in the margins, no page number, no catchword.

main_text.l: Quod Marte præstas, quodque limes Belgij
nova Nuper beasti, quæque tot claros viros
Quo cive solo gloriari plus potes,
At hæc prius fuere; nunc jacet jacet
Et tu GRONINGA cive quæ magno
Quæ condis ossa maximi hoc ævo senis,
Qui gesta condat, unum præter EMMIUM.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Asserta" (first letters could be read as "Afferta"); "beasti" and "Ocellus" as printed; the title's italic words "supremâ" and "curiâ" carry a superscript-like mark over the a, kept as printed. The line-end hyphen in "Frisio-rum" is printed. Digitiser's watermark at lower right omitted.
